Human review of final observable text/file delivery and relevant failure behavior in both channels.

Mocking plan:
No mocks or test authoring in this gate; downstream E2E records external fixture boundaries.

Documentations to update:
Record approving human, date, source message/review, approved scenarios and implementation revision in this issue. Remain open until explicit approval; reopen if material behavior changes.

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable — human acceptance tracking only.

Owner policies: docs/testing-approach.md#feature-e2e-approval-gate, docs/e2e-testing.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Depends on implementation and validation; blocks consolidated E2E authoring.
